newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank names UK bond origination head.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank names UK bond origination head.

text.p: The Royal Bank of Scotland said it has appointed Graham Buck, formerly of HSBC Markets, to oversee UK bond origination in its Treasury and Capital Markets operation.
Buck will report to Capital Markets Director Chris Gaskarth and will develop financial structures for its corporate and institutional clients.
Royal Bank said in a statement that it is currently active in areas such as public sector finance, project finance and asset-back markets where bond financing is increasingly common.
